summary: Apyx Medical Corp filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, regarding a letter agreement with Chairman Stavros Vizirgianakis appointing him Executive Chairman. Mr. Vizirgianakis will provide strategic oversight and investor engagement but will not be an officer or employee. The Board granted him 450,000 restricted stock units: 150,000 vest immediately, 150,000 vest ratably starting first anniversary, and 150,000 starting second anniversary, subject to continued service. Terms include stock-settled RSUs governed by the 2023 Plan. The filing standardizes leadership expansion without merger or acquisition. No deal mechanics, premiums, or regulatory clocks apply; watch for operational updates under new executive oversight.
